name: Matrix LLC

summary.text: Matrix LLC is a Montgomery, Alabama political consulting firm founded by Joe Perkins that has worked for utilities including Alabama Power and Florida Power & Light. Leaked Matrix documents reported by the Orlando Sentinel, Miami Herald and Floodlight in 2021-2022 tied former Matrix employees to Florida's 2020 'ghost candidate' campaigns and to memos proposing layered nonprofit funding structures for FPL. Matrix and Perkins say former CEO Jeff Pitts acted without their knowledge; Pitts says Perkins knew. The FEC deadlocked 3-3 in 2024 on a complaint against FPL.

facts.claim: The reporting on Matrix and FPL by the Miami Herald, Orlando Sentinel and Floodlight drew on leaked Matrix documents; Jeff Pitts claims Joe Perkins leaked them, which Perkins has not confirmed.
facts.quote: the reporting on Matrix and FPL came from the Miami Herald, the Orlando Sentinel, and a nonprofit investigative journalism website called Floodlight, and that it drew on leaked Matrix documents

facts.claim: According to a complaint to the FEC, Jeff Pitts, then at Matrix, sent FPL's then-CEO Eric Silagy two memos in November 2019, one proposing a funding structure for 2020 activities with a flowchart showing money passing through layers of corporate entities, mainly nonprofits, before funding political activity.
facts.quote: The funding memo included a flowchart showing how money could pass through several layers of corporate entities, mainly nonprofits, before funding political activity.

facts.claim: Nonprofits apparently tied to former Matrix consultants, including Pitts, made several donations to federal super PACs in 2020; Matrix said those consultants acted without the firm's knowledge or authorisation.
facts.quote: Matrix later said those consultants acted without the firm's knowledge or authorization.

sources.title: FEC deadlocks on allegations FPL broke law, used conduits to hide ties to ghost candidates

facts.claim: Through an attorney, Matrix and Joe Perkins demanded retractions and said neither Perkins nor any Matrix employee provided services to or had involvement in any Florida ghost-candidate campaign.
facts.quote: neither Perkins nor any Matrix employee provided legitimate services to, or had direct or indirect involvement in, any Florida ghost candidate campaigns

sources.title: FEC deadlocks on allegations FPL broke law, used conduits to hide ties to ghost candidates

facts.claim: Perkins has called Pitts a 'rogue employee' and argues in litigation that Matrix is not responsible for his conduct; Pitts says in court filings that Perkins knew everything.
facts.quote: Perkins has called Pitts a "rogue employee" and argues in a lawsuit that Matrix is not responsible because Pitts acted without his knowledge or consent.

facts.claim: In February 2024 the FEC split 3-3 on a complaint by CREW alleging FPL used Matrix-linked nonprofits to hide political spending, and closed the file without finding reason to believe FPL violated federal election law.
facts.quote: The commission reached that decision in late February, without finding reason to believe FPL violated the FECA.

facts.claim: Floodlight and NPR reported in 2022 that Matrix's work for Southern utilities included funding news sites that attacked utility critics.
facts.quote: In the Southeast, power company money flows to news sites that attack their critics
